A '''female Arkanian offshoot''' lived at some point between the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. She was a medical student and became involved as a researcher in the project of [[Demagol|Antos Wyrick]], a [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] scientist, who sought to create [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children at his [[New Generation Academy|school]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Osadia]]. Using genetic material of the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]], the researchers attempted to modify children in vitro to enhance them with Force-sensitivity. The woman and [[Edessa's father|her husband]], another researcher, became the parents of the first child, a daughter named [[Jarael|Edessa]], which meant "triumph" in [[Arkanian (language)/Legends|Arkanian]]. However, several years later the school was attacked by [[Skyreaper drone]]s of the slaver organization called [[the Crucible]], and all children, including young Edessa, were taken captive.
